issue.title: [bug] Drift 误报：Claude Code 的 `exit` 记录不带斜杠前缀，被 lastJSONLTime 当成一次使用，反复提示 bypassed
issue.body:
## 环境

- magpie 0.1.1318
- Claude Code 2.1.307
- Windows 11 (build 26200)

## 现象

Agents 页的 Claude Code 反复提示「绕过了 magpie」（Drift `kind: "bypassed"`），但实际请求全部正常经网关转发；提示出现时甚至当天网关零请求（`routing/<date>.jsonl` 未生成）。

`applied.json` 与 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中各字段（model / 各 tier effort）完全一致，`managed-settings.json` 不存在，项目级 `settings.json` / `settings.local.json` 均无 `ANTHROPIC_*` 覆盖 —— 即配置侧不存在任何漂移或绕过。

## 复现步骤

1. Claude Code 接入 magpie 网关，正常对话若干轮；
2. 用 `/exit` 退出会话；
3. 让 magpie 在该退出之后写一次 `applied.json`（重启 magpie、改模型、启动时的 Sync 都会写）；
4. 打开 Agents 页 → Claude Code 报 `bypassed`。

## 根因

`internal/agent/claude.go` 中 Claude Code 的 `LastUsed` 取 `history.jsonl` 的全局最新时间戳：

```go
// every prompt typed into Claude Code goes into history.jsonl
LastUsed: func() time.Time {
    return lastJSONLTime(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(path), "history.jsonl"), "timestamp", "display")
},
```

而 `lastJSONLTime`（`internal/agent/applied.go`）仅以**斜杠前缀**过滤 agent 自行回答的命令：

```go
var text string
if json.Unmarshal(m[textKey], &text) == nil && strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(text), "/") {
    continue
}
```

问题在于：Claude Code 把 `/exit` 落盘为**裸词 `exit`（不带斜杠）**，该过滤失效，于是：

1. `exit` 被当作一次真实提问，`LastUsed` 被推进到退出时刻；
2. 会话随即结束，自然没有任何请求到达网关，`lastSeen` 停留在更早的时间；
3. `bypassed()` 五个条件全部成立，判定为绕过。

comments.body:
Possible fix for this, in case it helps:

**Root cause.** Claude Code writes the `/exit` and `/quit` it answers itself into `history.jsonl` as the bare word (`exit` / `quit`, per the report here; I didn't verify that independently). `lastJSONLTime` only passes over lines starting with `/`, so the exit moves Claude Code's `LastUsed` past the gateway's last request and Drift then reports it as bypassing magpie.

**Change.** `lastJSONLTime` takes an optional list of bare words an agent answers locally; Claude Code's `LastUsed` passes `exit` and `quit`. Codex's prompt log reads as before.

**Red before the fix** (new `internal/agent/claude_lastused_test.go`):
```
--- FAIL: TestClaudeLastUsedSkipsExit (0.00s)
    claude_lastused_test.go:27: LastUsed = 2026-10-22 11:46:06 +0800 CST, want the prompt at 2026-10-22 11:44:06 +0800 CST
FAIL	github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/agent
```
Green after.

**Checks** (temp `HOME`): `gofmt -l` clean; `go vet` + `go build` for linux (nogui) and windows pass; `go test -tags nogui ./...` passes except `internal/plugin` `TestPluginProxy` / `TestPluginHTTP2TakesTheProxy`, which time out the same way on untouched `origin/main` in my sandbox (no network). darwin `go vet`/`go build`: not run (no cgo toolchain on Linux).

Compare: https://github.com/yetone/magpie/compare/main...ump45nose:magpie:fix/3224-claude-exit-drift

<details><summary>git format-patch</summary>

```diff
From 9b6a03740a5ae05bbda224b8568e400909257166 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: ump45nose <1729065730@qq.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:39:43 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] agent: leaving Claude Code with /exit no longer shows it as
 bypassing magpie (#3224)

Claude Code writes the /exit and /quit it answers itself into history.jsonl
as the bare word, without the slash lastJSONLTime skips. The exit moved
LastUsed past the gateway's last request, so Drift said "bypassed" when
magpie was next applied. Claude Code's LastUsed now passes over a bare exit
or quit; Codex's prompt log reads as before.

Reported by @IceLine389.
---
 internal/agent/applied.go              | 12 ++++++-----
 internal/agent/claude.go               |  6 ++++--
 internal/agent/claude_lastused_test.go | 29 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 40 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 internal/agent/claude_lastused_test.go

diff --git a/internal/agent/applied.go b/internal/agent/applied.go
index 23fdc0ce..abbef963 100644
--- a/internal/agent/applied.go
+++ b/internal/agent/applied.go
@@ -859,9 +859,9 @@ func (a *Agent) reconnect(now map[string]string) (bool, error) {
 
 // lastJSONLTime reads the newest Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds)
 // under key in the last lines of a prompt log, passing over the lines whose
-// text (under textKey) is a slash command: those an agent answers itself.
-// Zero if there is none.
-func lastJSONLTime(path, key, textKey string) time.Time {
+// text (under textKey) is a slash command, or one of the bare words in
+// local: those an agent answers itself. Zero if there is none.
+func lastJSONLTime(path, key, textKey string, local ...string) time.Time {
 	f, err := os.Open(path)
 	if err != nil {
 		return time.Time{}
@@ -880,8 +880,10 @@ func lastJSONLTime(path, key, textKey string) time.Time {
 			continue
 		}
 		var text string
-		if json.Unmarshal(m[textKey], &text) == nil && strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(text), "/") {
-			continue
+		if json.Unmarshal(m[textKey], &text) == nil {
+			if text = strings.TrimSpace(text); strings.HasPrefix(text, "/") || slices.Contains(local, text) {
+				continue
+			}
 		}
 		n, err := strconv.ParseInt(string(m[key]), 10, 64)
 		if err != nil {
diff --git a/internal/agent/claude.go b/internal/agent/claude.go
index 38d2c485..d60b03ad 100644
--- a/internal/agent/claude.go
+++ b/internal/agent/claude.go
@@ -2145,9 +2145,11 @@ func claudeIn(at place) *Agent {
 			}
 			return wiringOff("Claude Code", path, getEnv, "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN", at.gwKey())
 		},
-		// every prompt typed into Claude Code goes into history.jsonl
+		// every prompt typed into Claude Code goes into history.jsonl, and
+		// so do the /exit and /quit it answers itself, as the bare word
+		// (#3224)
 		LastUsed: func() time.Time {
-			return lastJSONLTime(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(path), "history.jsonl"), "timestamp", "display")
+			return lastJSONLTime(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(path), "history.jsonl"), "timestamp", "display", "exit", "quit")
 		},
 		// a session takes a new CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL on its next
 		// request, but settings.json's effort and ultracode, and the env's
diff --git a/internal/agent/claude_lastused_test.go b/internal/agent/claude_lastused_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..9aaa2df2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/agent/claude_lastused_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+package agent
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// Claude Code writes the /exit and /quit it answers itself into
+// history.jsonl as the bare word, with no slash (#3224). Leaving a session
+// is not a use: counted as one, it put LastUsed after the gateway's last
+// request and Drift said "bypassed".
+func TestClaudeLastUsedSkipsExit(t *testing.T) {
+	home, _ := claudeSettings(t, `{}`)
+	cc := claude(home)
+	asked := time.Now().Add(-10 * time.Minute).Truncate(time.Second)
+	var lines string
+	for i, display := range []string{"fix the test", "exit", " quit ", "/model"} {
+		lines += fmt.Sprintf(`{"display":%q,"timestamp":%d}`+"\n", display, asked.Add(time.Duration(i)*time.Minute).UnixMilli())
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "history.jsonl"), []byte(lines), 0o600); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got := cc.LastUsed(); !got.Equal(asked) {
+		t.Fatalf("LastUsed = %v, want the prompt at %v", got, asked)
+	}
+}
-- 
2.47.3

```
</details>

_AI assistance disclosure: the fix, test and this comment were prepared with an AI assistant; the checks above were actually run._

Adopted and verified @ump45nose's fix from this thread, with `Co-authored-by` credit preserved:
https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/claude-exit-drift

Claude's LastUsed now passes over bare `exit` and `quit` records, as well as slash commands. Those local commands therefore cannot move its prompt timestamp past gateway traffic and produce a false bypass indication. The optional filtering is Claude-specific: Codex's bare `exit` still counts as a prompt.

I reproduced the retained `TestClaudeLastUsedSkipsExit` failure on the previous code: it returned the exit timestamp instead of the real prompt timestamp. After the fix, that regression, an added Codex bare-exit control and `TestDriftBypassed` pass with `-race -count=20` under an isolated HOME using Go 1.26.8.

Combined verification at https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c61bf9b7315a12ccde15e0b6ef393f5e51771019: Go 1.26.8, umask 027, isolated HOME with caches pinned; native/Linux nogui/Windows vet and builds passed, and `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` passed (69 packages passed, 19 have no tests). Windows validation is cross-vet/build; native Windows/macOS runtimes were not exercised.

The tests use the history shape reported here; I did not launch a live Claude session or inspect a user's real history.

issue.title: [bug] Drift 误报：magpie 自己起的 Claude Code（订阅桥接 / 额度预热）写入 `~/.claude/history.jsonl`，被当成用户使用，反复提示 bypassed

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 环境

- magpie 0.1.2861（`magpie gui agents`）
- Claude Code 2.1.314（`/usr/bin/claude` → `/opt/claude-code/bin/claude`）
- Linux（Arch，kernel 7.2.11）
- Claude Code 的 `~/.claude/settings.json` 已指向网关（`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3425`）
- 同时使用 Claude Desktop 接入 magpie，模型走 Claude 订阅（`provider: claude`），有 3 个已保存的 Claude 账号并开启了额度预热

## 现象

Agents 页的 Claude Code 每天会多次出现：

> Claude Code 最近绕过了 magpie，重新应用后请重启
> Claude Code was used at 21:50 but none of its requests reached magpie — one started before magpie set it up still runs on its old config: restart it

但出现提示的时候，本机并没有用户自己启动的 Claude Code 在运行。点「重新接入」也没用，过一会儿又会出现。

## 原因

和 #3224 是同一个检测入口：Claude Code 的 `LastUsed` 取的是 `~/.claude/history.jsonl` 里最新一条非斜杠命令的时间。但这次推进 `LastUsed` 的记录不是用户写的，而是 **magpie 自己起的 `claude` 进程** 写的。这些进程用的是默认配置目录 `~/.claude`，它们发的消息会跟用户的输入一起写进同一个 `history.jsonl`，而且请求本来就直接发给 Anthropic，不经过网关。网关这边 `agent: "claude"` 的 `lastSeen` 不会更新，于是被判成 bypassed。

我遇到了两种触发：

### 1. 额度预热（21:50 那次）

`history.jsonl`：

```json
{"display":"hi","timestamp":1793713835656,"project":"/tmp/magpie-claude-work-1000","sessionId":"f11ebda6-35a6-4842-a230-cbbfda5c07b2"}
```

对应 `app.log`：

```
2026/11/03 21:50:37 claude warm-up: <account>'s 5 hours window: Claude Code: You've hit your weekly limit · resets 12am (Asia/Shanghai)
```

这次预热因为周额度用完失败了，但 `hi` 已经写进了 `history.jsonl`。从当天的记录看，每次预热都会留下一条 `/tmp/magpie-claude-work-1000` 下的 `hi`（09:29、09:45、12:52、14:30、14:46、21:50 等）。

### 2. 订阅桥接（15:35 那次）

Claude Desktop 的会话由 magpie 起的桥接进程代跑：`magpie claude-tui-helper /usr/bin/claude -p … --resume 225a7e0a-…`，cwd 是用户的项目目录，进程环境里没有 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`。Desktop 用户发的消息会以用户项目作为 `project` 写进 `history.jsonl`：

```json
{"display":"[Image #6][Pasted text #7 +3 lines]","timestamp":1793691330048,"project":"/home/saki/Documents/workspace/bdr","sessionId":"225a7e0a-ae66-49f6-976b-c3d5d32f40e5"}
```

同一时刻网关的 routing 日志记录的是 `agent: "claude-desktop"`，不是 `claude`：

```
2026-11-03T15:35:30 agent=claude-desktop model=auto/claude-opus-5-5 provider=claude status=200
```

注意：这种情况下 `project` 是用户的真实目录，所以只按 `/tmp/magpie-claude-*` 过滤并不够。

### 网关这边的对照

当天 routing 日志里 `agent: "claude"` 只有两条，都是我手动在终端里跑 `claude` 测试的，而且都正常经过了网关：

```
2026-11-03T15:02:30 kiro/claude-opus-5.5 kiro 200
2026-11-03T21:53:03 kiro/claude-opus-5.5 kiro 200
```

所以 15:02 之后、21:53 之前的两次提示，`LastUsed` 都是被 magpie 自己的进程推进的。

## 观察到的一个不一致

同样是 `claude-tui-helper` 起的进程，15:48 起的那一个环境里带 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.config/magpie/claude-accounts/<id>`，它的消息没有写进 `~/.claude/history.jsonl`。13:52 / 13:57 起的两个（`--resume` 旧会话）以及预热进程用的则是默认 `~/.claude`。看起来是否隔离取决于走的是哪个账号或哪条路径。

## 可能的修法（供参考）

1. magpie 起的所有 `claude` 进程（桥接、预热、`/usage` 读取）都用独立的 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`，不要写用户的 `~/.claude`。这样也能顺带解决 #3983 里桥接会话混进用户会话列表的问题。
2. 或者 `LastUsed` 跳过 magpie 自己产生的记录：magpie 知道自己起过哪些 `sessionId`（桥接的 `--resume` / `--session-id`、预热的会话），可以按 `sessionId` 排除；只按 `project` 前缀判断，盖不住第 2 种情况。
3. 至少预热失败（额度已满）时，不应该让这次调用被当成用户使用。

相关：#3224（`exit` 记录导致的同类误报）、#3983（桥接会话出现在用户会话列表里）。

issue.title: Claude Code 附属 config 目录（`claude#<name>`）的请求归因不到该行，drift 反复误报 bypassed

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### magpie version

magpie 0.1.4313，macOS（darwin/arm64）

### Where

GUI

### OS

macos27

### Agent, provider and model

Claude Code 使用独立配置目录启动（`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-<name>`），magpie 在 Agents 页把它识别成 `claude#<name>` 一行，并已正常 wire（模型、effort 都是 magpie 的）

### Steps to reproduce

**复现步骤**

1. 在 home 下建一个 `.claude-<name>` 目录，让 magpie 识别为 `claude#<name>` 这一行，并在 Agents 页 wire 好
2. 用 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-<name> claude` 打开会话，正常对话
3. 观察 Agents 页该行：约 30 秒后变红，提示
   `… was used at HH:MM but none of its requests reached magpie — one started before magpie set it up still runs on its old config: restart it`
4. 每发一条消息，红色先短暂消失，约 30 秒后又出现
5. 退出会话后立即用 `-r` 恢复同一会话，**还没输入任何内容**就已经是红的
6. 同一时段看 routing / usage 记录：该会话的请求全部 200，且确实经由 magpie 的网关



### What happened, and what you expected

**期望**

请求确实到达网关时，不应报 bypassed；至少在该 profile 的请求无法归因时，不应该判定为“绕过”。

**根因（读 0.1.4313 / main 的代码）**

1）`internal/agent/applied.go` 的判定带 30 秒宽限，这解释了“说话后短暂正常、随后又红”：

```go
func bypassed(used, applied, seen time.Time) bool {
        const grace = 30 * time.Second
        return !used.IsZero() && used.After(started) && used.After(applied) &&
                time.Since(used) > grace && seen.Before(used.Add(-2*time.Second))
}
```

`used` 来自 `LastUsed`，即 `<configdir>/history.jsonl` 里最后一条 `display` 不以 `/` 开头的记录。Claude Code 会把 `quit` / `exit` 这类不带斜杠的输入也写进 history.jsonl，于是“退出”本身被当成一次使用（与 #3224 同类问题）。这解释了第 5 步：`-r` 刚进来、还没说话，`used` 已经是退出时那条记录的时间。

2）更关键的是 `lastSeen(a.ID)` 永远为 0：

- `claude#<name>` 行的 id 是 `claude#<name>`（`internal/agent/claude_dirs.go`），且注释明确写着该行不保留 UA / 命令，“the claude row keeps … the requests”
- 网关侧 `internal/gateway/gateway.go` 的 `agentOf()` 依次看：路径里的 `/agent/<id>`、token 前缀 `magpie-<id>`、Desktop/Science 专用 UA，最后回落到 User-Agent → `usage.AgentOf("claude-cli/…")` → `claude`
- 而 `internal/agent/gatewaykey.go` 的 `keyAt()` 在本机 loopback 上返回的是 `gateway.Token`（裸的共享 key），不会写成 `magpie-claude#<name>`；`internal/agent` 也没有给 Claude Code 的 profile 行写 `/agent/` 路径

结果：Claude Code 附属目录的所有请求都记在 `agent: "claude"` 名下，`usage.LastSeen("claude#<name>")` 恒为 0，`bypassed()` 里的 `seen.Before(used-2s)` 恒成立 → 只要 `LastUsed > 最后一次 apply + 30s`，就必然误报。
